items.what: Whether the Panchayati Raj Ministry formally issues guidance requiring EPIC (voter ID) for panchayat-scheme beneficiaries.
items.expected: Lalan Singh announced it on Nov 6 at the Jan Yojana Abhiyaan workshop (IANS).

items.what: FOMC decision on a quarter-point rate hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting
items.expected: Markets price about an 85% chance of a hike after the strong October jobs report (Reuters); Daly expects further tightening

items.what: FAA Administrator Bedford's House T&I testimony on the air-traffic-control overhaul and the $30bn funding request
items.expected: Reuters: testimony on Tuesday next week

items.what: Whether CDC entry suspensions for travellers from DR Congo, Uganda and South Sudan (set to run to Nov 10) are extended or lifted
items.expected: CDC order: suspensions run to Nov 10; the attestation order continues

items.what: Constitutional Tribunal General Assembly on lifting the immunity of Święczkowski (including consent to detain him) and Sochański
items.expected: Called by Korwin-Piotrowska for Nov 17. The Palace and the Święczkowski camp dispute her authority, and attendance and quorum are uncertain.

items.what: Market reaction (złoty, 10-year yields) to S&P's negative outlook, and any Palace response
items.expected: Economists expect yields to stay high rather than jump.

items.what: Ruczaj beaver habitat (ul. Obozowa): police proceedings after the RDOŚ and city reports, the University of Agriculture beaver count, and whether ATAL's retention-reservoir work is halted or redesigned.
items.expected: The city has ordered permanent municipal-guard patrols and asked scientists to assess how many beavers are present (LoveKraków).

items.what: Name of the person appointed as the mayor's envoy for legal violations, and the first cases they refer.
items.expected: LoveKraków reports that staffing the post is the next step.

items.what: GDDKiA signs the 76.6m zł Jawornik (Zakopianka) interchange contract once appeals are exhausted.
items.expected: GDDKiA will sign once the choice of contractor is final; opening is planned for spring 2029.

items.what: Karnataka–oil companies E20 dispute: whether the Petroleum Ministry or the oil companies agree to joint retesting with counter-samples, or Karnataka takes legal or regulatory action under the 2005 Motor Spirit order.
items.expected: Karnataka says it will keep testing and publish results. The oil companies demand that statutory sampling procedures be followed.

items.what: How many ASDD voters are restored in the seven states under the ECI's Nov 6 order, and any deadline or final-roll date.
items.expected: The ECI order sets up a monitoring mechanism. Congress calls it a 'U-turn' and will keep campaigning, with a rally planned on Dec 14.

items.what: The Section 301 suspension of port fees on Chinese-linked vessels and the 178 China product exclusions expire at 11:59pm ET on Nov 9. USTR proposed on Oct 23 to extend the suspension to Jan 9, 2027 (docket USTR-2026-0694), but no final notice had been found.
items.expected: USTR Federal Register notice; Bessent said the US-China truce runs to Jan 10, 2027

items.what: House vote on Rep. Massie's privileged resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth during the lame duck
items.expected: Massie (Roll Call, WSB-TV)

items.what: First operations or interdictions by CENTCOM's new Task Force Iron Gate on Iran's land and Caspian routes, and any wider US strikes beyond the limited Qeshm hits
items.expected: CENTCOM / Adm. Brad Cooper

items.what: Charges against the Kraków attacker (Michał O.) once his condition allows, the official motive finding, and whether anyone helped him
items.expected: National Prosecutor's Office / Tusk (Nov 7 briefing)

items.what: Government or parliamentary proposals to tighten access to firearms and sport-shooting permits after the Kraków attack
items.expected: Implied by the public debate over the attacker's legally held arsenal (Interia, bezprawnik.pl)

items.what: Energy Minister's notice on maximum fuel prices for Nov 10 onward, or the end of the caps
items.expected: Dziennik.pl notes the caps are set only through Nov 9
